name: Xinjiang Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, production, and sale of agricultural and livestock machineries in China and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Agricultural Machinery and Aerospace. It offers self-propelled silage, corn and corn kernel, forage, sweet and tracked corn, chili, and grain combine harvester machines. The company also provides aerospace vehicle structural and engine core, rocket fuel tank wall panels and rocket body structural, and aviation aluminum alloy structural components, as well as titanium alloy battery casings.
